name: windows-desktop-control
description: Windows desktop control tools for Codex using UI Automation, screenshots, and input fallbacks.

interface.shortDescription: Control native Windows apps through Codex.
interface.longDescription: Adds a local MCP server for multi-display screenshots, window placement, input, app launch, and UI Automation inspection and invocation on Windows.
defaultPrompt: Inspect the available Windows displays, move a target app onto a chosen display, and describe the visible controls.
Launch Notepad on a secondary display, type a note, and save a display-specific screenshot.
Use UI Automation when possible, then fall back to display-relative clicks only if needed.
